findings.message: Module `sram_sp` has registered read `rdata <= mem[addr];` which means `rdata` lags `addr` by 1 cycle. Consumer may incorrectly read it as combinational. Fix options: (a) document in module header as '1-cycle read latency' / 'registered read'; (b) add a companion `output rdata_valid` strobe; (c) if combinational is intended, use `assign rdata = mem[addr];` instead.
